news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company's interest payments are not well covered by earnings. Net interest cover: 3.0x This is considered a major risk. If the company is unable to fund interest repayments on its debt through profits, it may be forced into reducing its debt burden through selling assets, undertaking a potentially costly capital raising or even into bankruptcy in the worst case scenario. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.22 (vs ₹2.13 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.22 (down from ₹2.13 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹630.9m (down 17% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹11.8m (down 43% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.9% (down from 2.7% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 5% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 24% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.01 (vs ₹3.04 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.01 (down from ₹3.04 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹691.0m (down 10% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹29.1m (flat on 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.2% (up from 3.8% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 12% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 24% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
